justification: Response mischaracterizes LPF stopband as creating interference hotspots; a stopband attenuates out‑of‑band signals, aiding mitigation. It adds unrelated phased‑array cost talk and does not explain how 25 GHz cutoff limits Ka‑band planning. While it mentions precoding, it fails to link the filter’s effect to frequency reuse decisions. Scores reflect poor technical accuracy, limited context use, and vague conclusions.
